title: Hypersonic Vehicle Control Surfaces
description: Thin swept/delta planform with internal stiffening ribs, leading edge with high-temperature oxidation protection, actuation lug
designPrinciples: Material: Ti-65 (Ti-6Al-4Sn-9Zr-1Mo-1W-0.3Si) is a high-temperature titanium specifically developed for sustained 600-650C service, offering 40% weight saving vs Inconel 718 for control surfaces.
Form: Plate stock for skin panels and ribs, with welded/fastened assembly. Hot sizing of formed panels to achieve aerodynamic contour accuracy.
engineeringTrends: Process: Hot forming of skin panels
Process: EB / laser welding of rib-skin assembly
comparisonNotes: Standards: Ti-65 per customer specification, STA condition, 100% FPI + dimensional inspection
relatedCapabilities: EB / laser welding of rib-skin assembly
